name: Gobfin Weapon Stack
description: Angry Shark still stacks in 1.0 — four Gobfin (or Ignis mix) plus a mount infusion (Chillet/Orserk) for player-weapon boss melts.

name: Orserk Bullet Ramp
description: 1.0 core: Orserk stacks Attack/Defense on the active Pal from bullet hits (up to +150%). Pair with a weakness DPS and Lyleen for long fights. Keep every species unique.

name: Energy Gunner
description: Trainer energy weapons + Orserk ramp. Xenogard / Xenolord amplify armed-Pal skills while Jetragon covers mobility and Dragon damage.

name: Status Punisher
description: Blind from Vanwyrm Cryst into a heavy active Pal (Astegon), with Orserk ramping and Shadowbeak pressure. Swap the DPS for the boss weakness.

name: Libero Raid Lead
description: Bellanoir Libero as the active nuke with Orserk stacks, Lyleen sustain, and Frostallion for Ice coverage on Dragon threats.

name: Knocklem Wall
description: Knocklem Iron/Steel Guardian Mode for long raids — Orserk still ramps the active slot, Lyleen heals, Anubis covers Earth utility.

name: Ice vs Dragon
description: Frostallion lead for Dragon bosses with Cryolinx support, Orserk stacks, and a flyer for repositioning.

name: World Tree Key
description: Panthalus opens the World Tree barrier — keep a flyer and a healer ready for the endgame route.

name: Fishing Build
description: Water party with fishing boosts for lunker hunting along the coast.

name: Loot Farmer
description: Drop-rate and ranch helpers for sphere materials, ore, and gold while surveying.

name: Pack Mule
description: Stacked carry weight for long survey and hauling runs.
